hook.text: When you buy a Tesla, insurance is embedded in the price. When you book Airbnb, host protection is automatic.

buildup.text: Embedded insurance bundles coverage into purchases at the point of sale.

discovery.text: The global embedded insurance market is projected to reach $722 billion by 2030.

twist.text: Convenience hides cost. Embedded insurance is often more expensive per unit than standalone policies.

climax.text: Embedded insurance trades choice for convenience. The product is seamless; the price may not be optimal.

punchline.text: $722 billion market by 2030. Insurance you never knew you bought.

quiz.question: What is a potential downside of embedded insurance?
options: It can be more expensive than standalone policies due to lack of comparison shopping
